deadline.intake: 2027-28 academic year: IELTS/TOEFL results deadline (applications open Oct 2026 - Aug 2027 for applicants from visa-on-arrival countries)

tuition.note: Undergraduate programmes, per academic year (2026/2027); same for local and international students (Foundation Year 12,000 USD)

requirement.text: IELTS 6.0 overall (writing 6.0, other parts 5.5) or equivalent TOEFL, taken in person. Academic proof: NUET score 120+ (at least 50 in Mathematics and in Critical Thinking), or digital SAT 1240 / ACT 26, or IB Diploma 30 points, or A-Level/NIS Grade 12 with at least ABB, or olympiad results with an interview. Application fee 10,000 KZT.
